notes.coordinates: All x/y are node centres in the map coordinate system, i.e. inside the SVG group with transform translate(30,20) scale(0.08). width/height are the node rectangle size; rectangles are centred on x/y.
notes.metabolite_roles: main = metabolite nodes of class nodeHM (main) and nodeSM (small/side, drawn like main metabolites); cofactor = nodeCM. Main-metabolite links are drawn with double-headed arrows, so substrate/product direction is not encoded in the SVG. Cofactor links have single arrows and are split into consumed (arrow points at the enzyme) and produced (arrow points at the cofactor).
notes.link_assignment: Links in the SVG carry no node references; each link endpoint was assigned to the node rectangle it touches (all within 20 map units).
notes.duplicate_check: For EC numbers occurring on several nodes of the same subsystem: relation of this node to each other node carrying the same EC, based on its metabolite sets.
notes.metabolite_nodes: metabolite_nodes lists every metabolite node with layout; reaction_node_ids shows which reactions share that drawn node.
